regimeSub: Post-hike digestion as 2Y retreats 7bps to 4.67% but 10Y stays elevated at 4.94% on persistent inflation fears.
themes: Fed Chair Warsh's Sept 16 hike to 4.0% digesting → 2Y yields ease 7bps to 4.67% from 4.74% as market recalibrates, but Warsh signaled 'one more tightening by end-2026' keeps terminal rate anxiety elevated
BOK rate gap pressure intensifies at 100bps post-Fed hike → USDKRW stabilizes at 1382 vs 1384 but Maeil Kyungjae reports BOK forced into defensive hiking cycle to prevent KRW collapse
Aug retail sales +1.2% MoM beat reinforces consumer resilience despite 1.5% Q2 GDP → stagflation trap deepens as strong demand undermines Fed's inflation fight, Core PCE stuck at 3.3%
Brent pulls back to $97.57 from Hormuz war-risk peaks but Iran-US clashes resume per Sept headlines → oil supply risk premium persists, constraining Fed's ability to declare inflation victory

headline: Fed Chair Warsh's second 2026 hike to 4.0% digests with 2Y yields easing 7bps but stagflation trap deepens as strong retail sales and 3.7% CPI collide with 1.5% GDP growth.
